Subject: The Beacon Headlamp: Built for the Trail, Waterproof to 20K
Preview: 400 lumens. 40 hours. Waterproof to 20,000mm. Your next trip just got a reliable light source.
Body: You know what it's like to be three miles from the trailhead when the sky goes dark. You've been there. The Beacon Headlamp is built for exactly that moment.

400 lumens of output — enough to read terrain, not just your feet. Up to 40 hours of runtime so you're not rationing light on a three-day trip. It weighs 95 grams, which means you'll forget it's on your head.

Waterproof to 20,000mm, the same standard as our jackets. Rain, stream crossings, a full dunking — the Beacon handles the same conditions your shell does.

USB-C rechargeable. One cable for your headlamp, your phone, your battery bank. Less to think about before you leave.

It's not built for cave diving or commercial diving operations. It's built for the trips you actually take — backpacking, alpine starts, base camp nights, the walk back to the car after a long day out.

The Northbay Beacon Headlamp. Straightforward light for people who know what they're doing.
